seo.title: Rooftop Brunch in Carlsbad, CA | Park 101
seo.description: Enjoy rooftop brunch in Carlsbad Village at Park 101, served daily until 2 PM with breakfast favorites, cocktails and open-air seating.

hero.heading: Rooftop Brunch in Carlsbad
hero.body: Open-air rooftop seating, breakfast favorites, breakfast burritos loaded with steak, and Rodeo Tower mimosas — served daily until 2 PM in Carlsbad Village.

intro.heading: Brunch With a Rooftop View
intro.body: Park 101 brunch pairs breakfast favorites and cocktails with an open-air rooftop in the heart of Carlsbad Village. Grab a table, settle in, and stay for the afternoon.

privateEvents.heading: Private Brunch Events in Carlsbad
privateEvents.body: Birthday brunches, baby showers, and group gatherings — reserve the rooftop or a section of the venue for your crew.

final.heading: Reserve Rooftop Brunch
final.body: Brunch is served every day until 2 PM. Reserve your table before the rooftop fills up.
